findings_addressed.oracle: Production constants in src/intellicrack/providers/huggingface.py: _DEFAULT_CONTEXT_WINDOW=4096 (line 123), provider stamp ProviderName.HUGGINGFACE (line 451), supports_streaming=True (line 455), name derivation via rsplit('/', maxsplit=1)[-1] (line 446) - each assertion is independently recomputed from the same rule the builder applies, not from the test's own injected values.
findings_addressed.documented_mutation: In src/intellicrack/providers/huggingface.py line 123, change `_DEFAULT_CONTEXT_WINDOW = 4096` to `_DEFAULT_CONTEXT_WINDOW = 8192` - this makes `assert model.context_window == _HUGGINGFACE_DEFAULT_CONTEXT_WINDOW` fail because the test uses the test-module constant 4096 while the builder stamps 8192.

notes: test_display_all_available_models was kept (not deleted) because it uniquely covers ALL models up to the MODELS_LIST_LIMIT=100 cap, whereas the sibling test_list_models_returns_model_info_instances only samples the first 20. The four isinstance-only checks were replaced with exact value assertions for the three builder invariants (context_window==4096, provider is HUGGINGFACE, supports_streaming is True) plus the name-derivation rule, mirroring the sibling's strength across the full listing.
